scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@relieve/shared && npm run build --workspace=@relieve/database && npm run build --workspace=@relieve/web && npm run build --workspace=@relieve/api
scripts.test: npm run test:config && npm run build --workspace=@relieve/database && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:config && npm run build --workspace=@relieve/database && c8 --reporter=json --report-dir=coverage/node npm run test:node --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:components --workspace=@relieve/web && node scripts/merge-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace=@relieve/database && npm run test:integration --workspace=@relieve/database
